name: LYW Cyber Technology Group Holding, Inc.
summary: LYW Cyber Technology Group Holding, Inc. does not have significant operations. Previously, the company, through its subsidiaries, engaged in the fabrication and sale of light gauge steel framing materials for commercial and residential structures. It also processed and sold flat rolled carbon steel products. LYW Cyber Technology Group Holding, Inc. was organized in 1987 and is based in Denver, Colorado.
